title: agentproto workstation e2b template — canonical pin declaration
description: Single source of truth for the versions baked into the agentproto-workstation e2b template and surfaced via scripts/sync-templates.mjs. Hand-edit this file, then run `node scripts/sync-templates.mjs` to regenerate the derived files.

baseImage.description: Base image the workstation Dockerfile builds FROM (ARG BASE_IMAGE).

cli.description: Pinned @agentproto/cli version baked into the template.

adapters.description: Adapter packages baked into the template, at exact pins.

runtime.description: Agent runtime CLIs baked into the template (e.g. opencode-ai), at exact pins.

tools.description: Standalone binaries baked into the template from pinned release tarballs (not npm).

gh.description: The GitHub CLI, installed from the official cli/cli release tarball (linux_amd64) and verified against the pinned checksum. Lets sandbox agents run `gh pr create` with the daemon-injected GH_TOKEN.

version.description: cli/cli release version, without the leading v.

sha256.description: sha256 of gh_<version>_linux_amd64.tar.gz, from the release's checksums.txt.

defaultSize.description: The size preset the bare stable alias (templates.stable) and the dev alias (templates.dev) are built at, and the size @agentproto/sandbox-e2b boots when a spec names neither config.size nor config.template. Must be a key of `sizes` whose preset is available.

sizes.description: Named size presets. Each is published as its own e2b template (templates.sizes.<preset>, alias `agentproto-workstation-<preset>`) and selected per spawn with the sandbox spec's `config.size`. The e2b CLI IGNORES e2b.template.toml for `template create -d Dockerfile`, so these are passed as `--cpu-count` / `--memory-mb` build flags; versions.json stays the single source of truth.

stable.description: The bare `agentproto-workstation` alias — built at `defaultSize` so callers that never name a size keep booting the same box.

dev.description: The dev channel (`agentproto-workstation-dev`), built at `defaultSize` from npm latest by `pnpm templates:refresh --channel dev --latest`.

sizes.description: One published template per `sizes` preset (same keys). An unavailable preset keeps id null.

cpuCount.description: vCPUs for sandboxes created from this preset's template (e2b `--cpu-count`).

memoryMb.description: Memory in MB for sandboxes created from this preset's template (e2b `--memory-mb`, must be even).

available.description: false when e2b refused to create the template (e.g. a plan limit). The preset stays declared so the refusal is visible; `config.size` on it fails with `unavailableReason`.

unavailableReason.description: The exact error e2b returned when the template could not be created. Required when available is false.

id.description: The published e2b template id (opaque). null when not yet published.

baked.description: What the published image was PROVEN to contain at its last real e2b build. null = unknown / out-of-band bake — consumers must assume the image does NOT match the declared pins.

cli.description: The @agentproto/cli version actually verified inside the published image.

adapters.description: Adapter package -> version actually verified inside the published image.

builtAt.description: When the published image was built (ISO 8601).

tools.description: Standalone tool -> version actually verified inside the published image (e.g. gh). Absent/null = not proven.
